seoTitle: Add a Payment Method in Squarespace: Stripe, PayPal & More
metaDescription: Link Stripe, PayPal, Square, or another payment method to your Squarespace store so you can start accepting payments online.
intro: Linking a payment method is one of the first things you need to do to start monetizing a Squarespace site, whether you're selling products, services, or accepting donations. This guide covers finding the payment settings and connecting a provider like Stripe.

steps.heading: Log in to Squarespace
steps.body: Sign in to your account, then navigate to your website from your dashboard to reach the backend where payment setup lives.

steps.heading: Search for payment settings
steps.body: Use the search bar in the top-left corner of your dashboard and type 'payment' to jump directly to the Payments option.

steps.heading: Choose your payment method
steps.body: Squarespace supports multiple payment methods — select the one that best suits your business, such as Stripe.

steps.heading: Connect your Stripe account
steps.body: Click to connect with Stripe, then log in or create an account and provide the business and banking details needed to receive payments.

steps.heading: Confirm your site is ready to accept payments
steps.body: Once linked, review your payment settings so you understand how transactions will be processed and reported going forward.

faq.question: Which payment methods can I add in Squarespace?
faq.answer: Options include Stripe, PayPal, Square, Apple Pay, and credit card processing, depending on your region and plan.

faq.question: Do I need a business bank account to connect Stripe?
faq.answer: Stripe will ask for business and banking details during setup to ensure you can receive payouts correctly.

faq.question: How do I find the payment settings quickly?
faq.answer: Use the dashboard's search bar and type 'payment' to jump straight to the Payments section instead of navigating menus manually.

faq.question: Is it safe to keep my payment information updated?
faq.answer: Yes, and it's recommended — keeping your payment details current and secure helps ensure smooth, uninterrupted transactions.
